title: Anth.us follow-up: freshness plugin on, a conversations section, latest story articles-only, verify self-updating /newsroom/, publish the three p.apyr.us docs
description: Repo: **Anth.us-web** (AnthusAI/Anth.us-web; merge to main IS deploy, see its AGENTS.md). One site PR, then verification, then the docs publish. Production deploy is approved for this epic (Ryan 2026-10-31). Site is on `@anthusai/papyrus` 5.64.0 (`package.json`, `infra/site.json` `papyrusVersion`). ## Changes 1. **Freshness on.** `papyrus.config.ts`: add `plugins: [{ name: "home-page" }]` to the backend config (the plugin reads `homePage.freshness` from `web/projection.json`, which already has `debounceSeconds: 300, purge: false`; keep them). Read `amplify/plugins/home-page/papyrus.plugin.ts` and `docs/home-page.md` "Freshness" in Papyrus for the exact key (`backend.plugins`) and what it synthesizes (Reference and Message table streams, `homePageTrigger`, debounce slot in the projection lock table, EventBridge Scheduler one-off schedules). No other backend change. 2. **Threads section.** `web/projection.json`: `homePage.threads` -> `{"enabled": true, "authors": "handle", "anonymousLabel": "Editor"}`. `web/pages/newsroom.md`: add a section 06 "Conversations" in the same `::raw` section shell as the others (eyebrow `06`, h2, lead) containing `::include{kind="threads" select="recent" count="6" layout="list" empty="No conversations yet."}`. Only public threads (anchored to a public Reference or a published Story) and `status: active` comment Messages are exported; authors show as the opt-in public handle or "Editor". 3. **Latest story articles-only.** Change the section 01 include to `::include{kind="listing" sections="articles" types="article" count="1" card="text" layout="bare" tag="ul" class="grid grid--list"}` and the "More stories" include to add `types="article"` with `skip="1"`. This needs the `types=` filter (Papyrus #912) released and the site bumped to that version; bump `package.json`, `infra/site.json` `papyrusVersion` and the Python pin together (the four pins must match, Papyrus AGENTS.md). 4. Tests: extend `tests/test_newsroom.py` (fixture `tests/fixtures/home-page/_data/home-page/` gains a `threads.json` and one `threads/.json`) so the page renders the threads list and the articles-only block. ## Verification (after merge) - Backend deploy finishes (Amplify job green); the content-actions function has the `home-page` stream trigger (read-only `aws lambda list-event-source-mappings` if credentials are available; otherwise the Amplify build log). - Accept one Reference in https://newsroom.anth.us. Within `debounceSeconds` (300 s) plus the edge lifetime (300 s) `https://anth.us/_data/home-page/references.json` `generatedAt` changes and the Reference appears under "Recently accepted" on https://anth.us/newsroom/ without any command being run. Record the timestamps on this task. - The reader-privacy scan (`procedures/newsroom/tests/reader_privacy.py` `identity_leaks()`) is clean on `/newsroom/`, `references.json`, `threads.json`. - Every other Anth.us page is byte-identical to before apart from the `?v=` hash (see the CSS-scoping task; until it lands, the hash change is expected and acceptable). ## Then: publish the docs Publish the three p.apyr.us How-To items (`howto-show-curation-on-the-public-site`, `howto-configure-home-page`, `howto-section-fronts`) through the CMS publish path: `papyrus ops content publish ` (`src/papyrus_content/publish_commands.py` `content_publish`, which runs the site triggers) against the p.apyr.us backend, or the newsroom console's Publish. Confirm each page is live on p.apyr.us and close PPY-c3ea18 with the URLs. ## Gherkin (Anth.us-web `tests/`, pytest-bdd style used there, or the repo's own test style if it has no Gherkin) Feature: The Anth.us newsroom page shows conversations and only articles as the latest story Scenario: A public thread appears in the conversations section Scenario: The latest-story block skips a newer page-type Story Scenario: No email, sub or UUID appears on the page or in the data files ## Rules Lucide icons only (the threads include already uses them); no borders; "Proposed Story" never "Draft"; no emails or ids in the repo. Dependencies: the types filter task (PPY types) must be released before step 3; steps 1, 2 and 4 can ship first in their own PR if #912 is slow.
